title: Nine Pounds and Eleven Hours
subtitle: 肉类与饮食 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 肉类与饮食（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）
meta: 主题语境：肉类与饮食（生活与学习·饮食与烹饪）　|　核心词汇：beef　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beef 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother bought ① a beef joint that weighed nine pounds and said the weighing was the whole of the occasion. The ② beef, meaning the meat and not the animal, was cooked for eleven hours and was argued about for eleven years; a beef, she said, is the only food that is judged by how long it took and not by how it tastes.

Every ③ beef in that house came from the same butcher, and the ④ beef on the Sunday, meaning the one cooked for the cousins and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever waited for. A beef, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part an oven you can trust; my mother said the oven is the part that fails.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ beef was the whole of the grievance, meaning the complaint and not the meat. The ⑥ beef, meaning the objection and not any of that, is the only argument that gets bigger the longer you keep it; a beef, he said, is either something you roast or the only word that means both a joint and a complaint. She said the complaint is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ beef had become a photograph in a cookbook, and the cookbook had become an argument about whether anybody had ever liked it. The ⑧ beef of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pounds of meat and eleven hours of oven; a beef, she said, is either the joint on the Sunday or the reason the cousins came. He said the cousins came for the argument.

The ⑨ beef I remember is the one on the Sunday, which was dry and was described as perfect for thirty years. A ⑩ beef, my grandmother said in 1968, is the only food that improves by being complained about; every beef, she said, is a grievance that has agreed to look like a joint. She said the grievance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 牛肉（指那块肉，与牲畜相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy a beef joint 买一块牛肉（大块烤肉）
D. n. 牛肉（指屋里每一块）
E. n. 牛肉（指星期天那一块）
F. n. 抱怨；牢骚（指那份不满）
G. n. 牢骚（抽象：那种反对意见）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a beef joint that weighed nine pounds
The beef, meaning the meat and not the animal
beef was the whole of the grievance

answers.why: buy a beef joint 意为“买一块牛肉”，1949 年母亲买了一块九磅重的牛肉，她说称分量就是这个场合的全部。
beef 意为“牛肉”，指那块肉而不是牲畜，它烤了十一个小时，却被人争论了十一年。
beef 指屋里每一块牛肉，每一块都来自同一个屠夫。
beef 指星期天那一块（专为表亲烤的那一块），是唯一有人真会等着的。
beef 意为“抱怨、牢骚”，指那份不满，父亲说 beef 就是那个不满的全部。
beef 为抽象用法，指那种反对意见，是唯一你搁得越久它越大的争论。
beef 意为“牛肉”，到 1965 年这个 beef 成了烹饪书里的一张照片。
beef 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九磅肉和十一个小时的烤箱。
beef 意为“牛肉”，我记得的是星期天那一块，它是干的，却被夸了三十年的完美。
beef 为抽象总称，祖母说牛肉是唯一会因为被抱怨而变好的食物。
